Advertisement NO. NPSC/EXAM-18/2023 dt. 19.08.2026 (Stenographer Recruitment Examination 2026) 
 Published on : 19-08-2026 03:51 pm 
 NAGALAND PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION 
 KOHIMA 
 NPSC/EXAM-18/2023 Dated Kohima, the 19 th August, 2026 
 ADVERTISEMENT
NO.NPSC-3/STENO-2026 
 Applications are invited for filling up the following vacancies
under the Government of Nagaland in the manner prescribed below: 
 Backlog
Vacancies: 2021 
 Item No. 1: 1 (one) post of Stenographer (Grade-III) under Power
Department (Reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disability) 
 Item No. 2: 1 (one) post of Stenographer (Grade-III) under Home Department, Police Establishment
Branch , (Reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disability) 
 Item No. 3: 1
(one) post of Stenographer 
(Grade-III) under Labour and Employment, Skill Development & Entrepreneurship
Development (Reserved for Persons
with Benchmark Disability). 
 Fresh Vacancies: 
 Item No. 4: 2 (two) posts of Stenographer (Grade-III) under Excise & Prohibition Department (1 post reserved for Indigenous
Inhabitants of Nagaland, 1 post reserved for B.T. Konyak) 
 Item No. 5: 3 (three) posts of Stenographer (Grade-III) under Labour and Employment, Skill Development &
Entrepreneurship Department (1 post
reserved for Indigenous Inhabitants of Nagaland, 1 post each reserved for B.T.
Phom & B.T. Sangtam) 
 Item No. 6: 8 (eight) posts of Stenographer (Grade-III) under Office of the Commissioner , Nagaland Kohima {5 posts reserved for
Indigenous Inhabitants of Nagaland, 1 post each reserved for B.T. Zeliang, B.T.
Yimchunger (Yimkhiung/Tikhir) & B.T. Chang} 
 Item No. 7: 4 (four) posts of Stenographer (Grade-III) under Higher & Technical Education Department 
(3 posts reserved for Indigenous Inhabitants of Nagaland, 1 post reserved for
B.T. Zeliang) 
 Item No. 8: 1 (one) post of Stenographer (Grade-III) under Horticulture Department (Reserved for
Indigenous Inhabitants of Nagaland) 
 Item No. 9: 2 (two) posts of Stenographer (Grade-III) under Economics & Statistics Department 
(1 post reserved for Indigenous Inhabitants of Nagaland & 1 post reserved
for B.T. Sumi of Kiphire) 
 Item No. 10: 1 (one) post of Stenographer (Grade-III) under Sericulture Department ( Reserved for
Indigenous Inhabitants of Nagaland) 
 Item No. 11: 1 (one) post of Stenographer (Grade-III) under Soil & Water Conservation Department {Reserved for B.T. Yimchunger (Yimkhiung/Tikhir)} 
 Item No. 12: 1 (one) post of Stenographer (Grade-III) under Nagaland Information Commission (Reserved
for B.T. Sangtam) 
 Qualification: 
 Item No 1 to 12: Graduate in any discipline with 6 (six) months
Diploma in Computer Operation and 1 (one) year course in Shorthand possessing a
speed of 80 words per minute. 
 Scale of Pay 
 Sl. No 
 Item Nos 
 Pay Band 
 Level 
 1 
 1 to12 
 28700-91300 
 8 
 Age as on
01.01.2026: Minimum -21 years Maximum -32 years 
 Note: 
 1. The upper age
limit is relaxable by: 
 (a) 5(five) years
for candidates belonging to SC/ST. 
 (b) Age concession
for serving Government employees will be allowed, the equal numbers of years
they are in service to a maximum of 5 (five) years. 
 2. 100% of the
vacancies are reserved for candidates to (a) Any Naga Tribe (b) Kuki (c) Kachari (d) Garo and (e) Mikir provided such
persons are Indigenous Inhabitant of the State of Nagaland. 
 3. Implementation
of reservation for backward tribes in the state shall be in accordance with the
notification issued vide NO.RCBT5/87(pt-II) dt. 14 th April 2011, 15 th 
June 2012 & 23 rd March 2022. 
 4. Reservation for
person with Disability, wherever applicable as sanctioned by the user
department in accordance with the Government Notification NO.AR-3/Gen-9/97 dt.
13 th August 2020, No.AR-8/NSSB-9/2022/57 dt. 5 th May 2022
and No. AR-3/Gen-9/97(Vol-II) dt. 8 th December 2025. 
 5. For the purpose
of availing reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities Form C, Form D
and Form E as mandated vide Notification AR-3/GEN-9/97 dt.13 th 
August 2020 for fresh vacancies. 
 6. In the absence
of PwBD candidates the backlog vacancies of 2021 shall be dereserved. 
 7. Terms &
conditions. 
 (i) Only those candidates who possess the requisite qualification
acquired from recognized university/institution at the time of applying will be
eligible to apply for the post(s). 
 (ii) Candidates must produce attested/self-attested
photocopies of the following documents/materials to the Commission as and when
called for. 
 a) HSLC/Matriculation/Equivalent
Admit Card for proof of Date of Birth. No other Certificate will be accepted
for age proof. 
 b) Indigenous
Inhabitant Certificate, Scheduled Tribe Certificate, Backward Tribe Certificate
as relevant and applicable. 
 c) For Person with
Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs), certificate from competent medical authority is
required. 
 d) Proof of
Educational Qualification: Mark Sheets & Pass certificates/provisional pass
certificates from matriculation onwards till requisite qualification. If for
any reason pass certificates/provisional pass certificates are not issued by
the Board/Institute/University, letter/certificate to that effect from Board/
Institute/University must be submitted. 
 e) All relevant
documents/certificates to be submitted should have been issued by the concerned
authority/institution/board/university on or before the last date of submission
of application form. 
 8. Indigenous
Inhabitant Certificate, S.C, S.T & B.T Certificates should be signed only
by District Authority not below the rank of Additional Deputy Commissioner. 
 9. IN CASE IT IS
DETECTED AT ANY STAGE OF RECRUIMENT THAT A CANDIDATE DOES NOT FULFIL THE
ELIGIBLITY NORMS AND/OR THAT HE/SHE HAS FURNISHED INCORRECT/FALSE INFORMATION
OR HAS SUPRESSED ANY MATERIAL FACT(S), HIS/HER CANDIDATURE SHALL STAND
CANCLLED. 
 10. Required shorthand speed (w.p.m.) must be mentioned
either on mark sheet or in their completion certificate. 
 11. The decision of the Commission in all matters
regarding eligibility, conduct of examination, other tests and selection would
be final and binding on all candidates. No representation or correspondence
shall be entertained by the Commission in this regard. 
 12. Application form will not be issued from the office of
the Commission. 
 13. Only OTR applications for Stenographer will be accepted. 
 14. OTR (One Time Registration ) will be available from
noon of 21 st August, 2026 till noon 2 nd September, 2026. Only those candidates who are
eligible to appear Stenographer Exam-2026 may register. 
 15. Online
application can be submitted through NPSC portal i.e https://npsc.nagaland.gov.in from noon of 21 st 
August,2026 till noon of 3 rd September,2026 . 
 16. For candidates
who are Government employees, “No Objection Certificate” should be uploaded
while submitting online application . 
 17. OTR (One Time
Registration) will be free of cost. Candidates have to pay examination fee of Rs. 300/-,
convenience fee of Rs. 25/- and payment gateway charges as applicable. 
 18. Any issue/complaints must be settled on or before
the last date of submission of application form. No complaints will be
entertained thereafter . For any queries / assistance candidates can call
the NPSC helpdesk number : 9402988506 on working days (10:00 hrs to 15:00 hrs) 
 19. Date of Exam will be notified in the Commission
Website. 
 (NUNGSANGMENLA IMCHEN) 
 Secretary, 
 Nagaland Public Service Commission, 
 Kohima
